name: Fat Brain Toys
description: Online toy store with its own checkout. Its shipping page states standard shipping within the 48 contiguous states, shipping to Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico and APO/FPO addresses via the US Postal Service, and international shipping through USPS Parcel Post.

ships_to.notes: Shipping page covers the 48 contiguous states plus Alaska, Hawaii, US territories and APO/FPO (USPS).

fulfillment.pickup_notes: No pickup option was found on the shipping page.
